text:
You need a system that can pull Foodticket/Orderbuddy order data, summarize all meals and ingredients, and send the entrepreneur a clear weekly overview without manual errors.  

I’m Mina Castellan, with 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, and dashboarding. I can build this as either a CRM-style workflow or an Excel-based solution, depending on what fits best with the API and the business process.  

Relevant experience:
- Sales KPI dashboard: built one Power BI report on a star-schema model replacing 14 separate Excel sales reports; monthly close reporting went from 3 days to 4 hours.
- Inventory reconciliation automation: built a Power Query workbook that matches warehouse counts to the ERP every week and flags variances; weekly reconciliation went from 6 hours to 20 minutes.

I can also provide an estimate for the build after reviewing the API structure and required output format.
